text: {"components": [{"type": "claim", "quote": "The Federal Chancellery supports and advises the departments in preparing for and managing interdepartmental crises.", "gist": "Federal Chancellery supports departments in interdepartmental crisis preparation and management"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "It carries out its crisis management tasks in accordance with the Government and Administration Organisation Act (GAOA) and the Ordinance on the Crisis Organisation of the Federal Administration (OCOFA).", "gist": "Federal Chancellery conducts crisis management tasks under GAOA and OCOFA"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Integrated Exercise 2025 (IE 25)", "gist": "IE 25, a nationwide crisis exercise"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "The Federal Council has also entrusted the Federal Chancellery with managing the Integrated Exercise 2025 (IE 25), a nationwide crisis exercise.", "gist": "Federal Council assigned Federal Chancellery to manage IE 25"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "The tasks of the Federal Chancellery in the area of crisis management have increased significantly since the evaluations of the Federal Administration's crisis management during the COVID-19 pandemic.", "gist": "Federal Chancellery's crisis management tasks grew significantly post-COVID-19 evaluations"}]}
